ABOUT ME

Where a passion for data meets a commitment to service.

I’m Ahad, 19, based in Carrollton, Texas. I’m studying Business Analytics & Artificial Intelligence at The University of Texas at Dallas, working toward a career as a data analyst / data scientist. I’m drawn to math and anything involving numbers, and I love the problem-solving side of working with data.

Service is a big part of who I am — I’ve been volunteering in my community since I was eight. Outside of school and volunteering, I enjoy technology and AI, and I love watching sports, mainly basketball and football.

VOLUNTEER EXPERIENCE & LEADERSHIP

Service is central to how I lead

Service and community are central to me. I’ve been a volunteer since I was eight, and today I give back at Jamatkhana, my religious community, almost every day. My focus is on the youth: I help them find opportunities to serve, work in harmony with the adults so both generations move forward together, and make sure every young person feels valued in the community space.

As an Eagle Scout through the Boy Scouts of America, I bring that same sense of responsibility and service to everything I lead. Across my roles, I’ve been responsible for the youth of the Jamat as well as the attendance data of 500+ students.
